title: Build larger, more detailed ProBuilder terminals and rack computers in the Test-scene lab
description:
## Summary
The Test-scene research lab (`Assets/Test.unity`) currently has only two flat, low-detail wall boxes acting as terminals (`Lab Console NE` at (12,1.3,20.9) and `Lab Console E` at (20.9,1.3,-10)), plus two plain retro CRT desks. Replace and extend them with larger, more detailed ProBuilder terminal furniture: one large multi-terminal console bank, singular operator consoles with a built-in desk + keyboard + monitor, and supporting rack computers. Each family must carry buttons, keyboards, screens, and lights, assembled from many ProBuilder submodels over a small reusable material/texture set.

Related: TSK-0243 (built the existing lab environment). Deferred follow-up: TSK-0258 (glass display cases).

## User Mandate
> "I want larger and more detailed terminals around the room. Especially a large multi terminal console + singular consoles with a built-in desk + keyboard + monitor, as well a supporting \"rack\" computers. They should have some buttons, keyboards, screens, and lights. Some glass display cases eventually would be cool, but can be tracked as future improvement. Use probuilder and a lot of submodels and materials/textures as needed"

STRICT. Binding constraints:
- Terminals are larger and more detailed than the current flat console boxes.
- Required pieces: at least one large multi-terminal console; singular consoles with a built-in desk + keyboard + monitor; supporting rack computers.
- Those terminals show buttons, keyboards, screens, and lights.
- Built with ProBuilder, from many submodels, with materials/textures as needed.
- Glass display cases are explicitly deferred to a future task, not built here.

## Scope
In scope: ProBuilder geometry, materials, procedural textures, prefab assets, and prefab instances placed in `Assets/Test.unity`; the two existing flat consoles are replaced.
Out of scope: glass display cases (TSK-0258); runtime C# gameplay code; changes to creature generation, DNA, mesh extraction, or editor tooling.

## Acceptance criteria
- One large multi-terminal console bank exists, larger than the old flat consoles, with multiple screens, button rows, and indicator lights.
- At least two singular operator consoles exist, each with a built-in desk, keyboard, and monitor.
- At least two supporting rack computers exist with rack blades, vents, and status lights.
- No terminal renders with a null/magenta material.
- New assets are reusable (prefabs + shared materials), and prop placement has no intersection with existing lab geometry.
- Unity console has no new errors; scene is saved; screenshots captured as evidence.
